items.title: Saline mayor hopefuls split on Oracle tax deal and campus size
items.dek: Candidates differ sharply on whether to grant Oracle a 12-year tax break for its proposed $43 billion data center complex. One side argues the project will overwhelm roads and wells; the other says the jobs and revenue are too big to lose. Saline voters will decide which vision prevails in November.
items.source_title: Saline Mayoral Candidates Offer Competing Visions - The Sun Times News
